What Apple Reference Mode actually does — listing honesty

Apple Reference Mode provides a color-accurate calibrated display state on supported hardware for pro workflows. On Mac with Studio Display or Pro Display XDR, enabling Reference Mode under System Settings → Displays locks the display to a reference color space so editors, colorists, and photographers can trust on-screen color for grading, proofing, and delivery. iPad Pro supports Reference Mode for pro photo and video workflows on its built-in display. Third-party apps may complement this by aligning color pipelines, documenting Reference Mode setup, or marketing pro grading workflows that assume a calibrated reference display. Reference Mode–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Pro display and color-grading marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Apple Reference Mode — not a literal paste of US marketing:

系统设置 → 显示器 → 参考模式

Apple's Chinese System Settings path on Mac is 系统设置 → 显示器 → 参考模式. Screenshot walkthroughs and caption lines should mirror that path — not English "Displays" badges alone, not 原彩显示 (True Tone), and not 夜览 (Night Shift). AppLocale uses the labels buyers see on a zh-Hans Mac when your English gallery shows the Reference Mode toggle on Studio Display or Pro Display XDR.

参考模式 (Reference Mode)

Apple's official zh-Hans label for the color-accurate calibrated display mode is 参考模式. Ultra Reference Mode badges on your US gallery should map to 参考模式 or 超参考模式 depending on your English source — not literal 引用模式, which reads like machine translation.

Studio Display 与 Pro Display XDR

When your English subtitle or description names the hardware — "Studio Display Reference Mode" or "Pro Display XDR color reference" — zh-Hans buyers expect Studio Display 参考模式 or Pro Display XDR 参考模式 on calibration walkthrough frames. Do not substitute 原彩显示 (True Tone) or 高动态范围 (HDR capture) when your English source only claims reference display calibration.

色彩准确与 D65 白点

US pages use "Color-accurate display", "D65 white point", or "Fixed gamma for grading." China marketing uses 色彩准确, D65 白点, and 固定伽马 on color-reference education frames. Do not substitute 原彩显示 (True Tone ambient matching) or 减少蓝光 (Night Shift blue-light reduction) — those belong on sibling pages.

Terms like 参考模式, 色彩准确, and 专业校色 each signal different intent from 原彩显示 (True Tone), 夜览 (Night Shift), or 显示缩放 (Display Zoom).
